summary: Design version 2 is in. Your two written-in answers are now real options you can click: QR2 gains (c) the TRANSIENT dim (the dark lasts the opening beat only), and Q24 gains (c) COMPACT AND FOLLOW (the column closes up and the light follows the slot). Both are the recommended default now. The glow-shader braindump is folded in too: two new root gates, QR9 (is the spotlight circle drawn by the glow shader, and does it move onto the card?) and QR10 (is the halation/bloom/LUT/grain film pipeline in scope at all?). 53 new questions, none of your 29 answers thrown away - the dim questions you already answered were re-gated so they survive if you switch QR2 to (c). Go back to QR2 first.
